authorizationBoundary.interpretedAuthorizedStage: formal MQ analysis of the terminal-PASS attempt-003 collection under the already frozen v2 scientific design

endpointAndEstimands.singleCcd: within-block equal-weight OLS slope of log(batchWallSeconds) on log2(workerCount) for W1, W2, W4 and W8
endpointAndEstimands.dualCcd: within-block log(batchWallSeconds at W16 / batchWallSeconds at W8)
endpointAndEstimands.populationEstimator: arithmetic mean of the 36 matched-block estimands

primaryInference.test: one-sample Student t test on the 36 block estimands
primaryInference.standardError: sample standard deviation of block estimands divided by sqrt(36)
primaryInference.multiplicity: Holm step-down adjusted p-values across exactly P1-P4 at familywise alpha 0.05

decisionInterval.kind: Bonferroni simultaneous one-sided upper confidence bounds across P1-P4
decisionInterval.reason: ordinary Holm-adjusted p-values do not uniquely determine a rectangular family of marginal intervals; the Bonferroni companion bounds provide auditable strong simultaneous coverage and are conservative while remaining multiplicity-compatible

primaryInference.claimRule: Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05 AND Bonferroni simultaneous upper bound < 0 AND point estimate <= MIPE

keySecondaryInference.gate: opens only if all P1-P4 have Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05
keySecondaryInference.testWhenGateOpen: one-sample Student t tests with Holm adjustment across exactly S1-S2
keySecondaryInference.decisionIntervalWhenGateOpen: Bonferroni simultaneous one-sided upper confidence bounds across S1-S2 at familywise confidence 0.95
keySecondaryInference.claimRuleWhenGateOpen: Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05 AND Bonferroni simultaneous upper bound < 0 AND point estimate <= MIPE
keySecondaryInference.whenGateClosed: estimates and ordinary intervals are descriptive only

sensitivityAnalyses.signedRank: exact conditional one-sample Wilcoxon signed-rank lower-tail p-value with zero differences removed and average ranks for ties

descriptiveAnalyses.conditionSummaries: geometric mean and ordinary two-sided 95 percent t interval for batchWallSeconds in each algorithm-by-condition cell
descriptiveAnalyses.stDirectVersusMqW1: within-block MQ-W1 versus ST-direct log ratio, estimate and ordinary two-sided 95 percent interval only
descriptiveAnalyses.crossAlgorithmInteractions: within-block differences of the corresponding single-CCD slopes and dual-CCD contrast, estimate and ordinary two-sided 95 percent interval only

softwarePlan.studentTImplementation: regularized incomplete beta plus deterministic bisection with frozen known-answer self-tests
